Each High Court consists of:
• A Chief Justice
• Other Judges

The number of judges is decided by the President of India.
The number of judges is decided by the President of India.

items: Frequently asked: The strength of a High Court is decided by the President of India, NOT Parliament.
Every High Court mandatory composition includes a Chief Justice along with other judges.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: Every High Court is composed of a Chief Justice and such other judges as needed.
The strength of a High Court is not fixed by the Constitution.
The authority to determine the number of judges in a High Court lies solely with the President of India.
